preserved_behavior: S now uses a distinct private SharedLocalEvaluated variant. The old Legacy, by-value Evaluated and SharedEvaluated remote branches retain their exact prior bytes and public contracts; strict local checks were not silently imposed on old remote paths.

The new S LocalSources wraps the same original remote observation implementation, delegates the original actual protocol, and adds concrete identity checks at prepare. It accepts no public arbitrary callback.
S and C local attestation dispatch keep FreshCreate -> original attest_source and Recovered -> original readback_source; no Fresh authority is reconstructed from recovered custody.

The original command owner's execution_requested/readback-only state remains derived from the consumed original receipt owner. The local S factory delegates the original shared factory and only selects its stricter private local variant afterward.

Version binding requires actual Published. Selection binding preserves the original predecessor bind and recovery-versus-current read path, full publication check and before/after equality. Each actual response keeps the original current checks; no old successful observation is accepted as a future live read.

Version local readback and readiness aliases share the same Arc, original permit, terminal slot, request counter and absolute end. The readiness adapter clones the same sealed local capability after original Material/D/S checks rather than constructing a second counter.

S and Version reads take their shared slot before fallible work. Error, timeout or cancellation cannot return the slot through a detached worker. Already-dispatched blocking work may finish; delivery stays Unknown. No cancellation is relabeled as proof that owner work never ran.

Export/bind cancellation can leave already-dispatched read-only work finishing and dropping its result/permit. It does not restore Fresh/Execute; this is distinct from an already-issued read capability's permanent absent-slot semantics.

Original T/E clients are still the same sealed Arc objects, preserving their original channel, nonce, aggregate 128-request counters and deadlines. Local capability counters are additional limits and do not replenish the T/E clients.

No new queue or retry loop was introduced. Busy/Unavailable from try_lock or the original client slot still rejects. Same-host typed references do not replace real socket peer identity across processes.

The purpose-enum successor changes internal bool/Option positional APIs to fixed enums with equivalent Readback/CompletionReadiness and Selection/NextUse mappings. The strict identity helpers remain byte-identical.
The doc-only successor preserves behavior and documents the private adapter restriction.
